title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: BCMCPProxy vNext
summary: BCMCPProxy vNext is a cross-platform .NET proxy that bridges Model Context Protocol clients with Business Central's API, upgraded from a Windows-only proof-of-concept to support macOS and Windows with improved performance, security, and modern .NET 10 architecture.
key_points: BCMCPProxy vNext evolved from the original Windows-only Microsoft project to support both Windows and macOS with .NET 10 and C# 13
Device code flow authentication provides browser-based sign-in with automatic clipboard copying and token caching across sessions
Performance improved 40-67% through sync-over-async elimination, async I/O, and better memory management
Cross-platform support includes Intel x64, Apple Silicon ARM64, and ARM64 processors through unified dotnet build
Security enhanced by removing hardcoded credentials and using platform-native secure storage for token caching

quotes.text: BcMCPProxy is an (unsupported) .NET project that provides a server proxy that bridges MCP clients with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central's API.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core purpose of the proxy as a bridge between MCP protocol clients and Business Central's API

quotes.text: The improved BCMCPProxy (here called BCMCPProxy vNext) represents an evolution from the original Windows-only proof-of-concept to a more robust solution.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the progression from original Windows-only implementation to a production-ready cross-platform version
